❓ New here? How to use this page
The 10 smartest watches to buy right now, ranked by an AI scoring model — not just the cheapest, the smartest.

How the AI Smart Buy Score works — every live offer is scored 0–100 by a weighted machine-learning pipeline:
• Price edge — how far below the HK wholesale median (needs ≥3 quotes for the exact variant)
• US arbitrage — the same watch's median price in the US dealer chats (parsed from their USD quotes); buy in HK, sell to the US at the gap
• Demand — live WTB requests from HK and US buyers
• Momentum — a least-squares regression on 8 days of price history; rising models are safer to buy today
• Seller trust — how many quotes this seller has posted historically and whether their prices track the market
• Anomaly guard — a robust z-score (median/MAD) flags too-good-to-be-true prices as VERIFY before you wire anyone.

STRONG BUY ≥75 · BUY ≥60 · CONSIDER ≥45 · WATCH below that. Projections are statistical fits, not guarantees — always verify the watch before wiring.
